picks.thesis: Q3 beat (adj. EPS $0.60 vs $0.55 in Q2, adj. EBITDA margin up to 17.5%) and a first 2027 outlook of mid-single-digit revenue growth with ~15% operating margins (~200 bp better) that assumes no North America recovery: a forward estimate change, with Brent near a five-month high behind it. Gap is moderate (+3.7% premarket to ~$34.20 vs $32.98). Wrong if it fills the gap below ~$33 (the 5% stop) or closes below VWAP on day one.

Q3 adj. EPS $2.50 (+12% y/y), margin +110 bp, full-year EPS guide raised to $9.10-9.15, plus an expanded Amazon data-center optics deal with a warrant that vests on $6B of sales: a lasting estimate change with only a ~1.2% gap (~$164 vs $162.01). Wrong if it closes below Monday's $162 close (the 4% stop sits just under).
